en.title: Saudi National Security, Resources 'Non-negotiable,' Prince Faisal Tells BRICS
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister declared at the BRICS summit that the kingdom's national security, territorial integrity, and resources are non-negotiable, warning Gulf states will not tolerate attacks on their territories or interests.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s security and territorial integrity are inviolable, Prince Faisal declares at BRICS Summit

en.title: Saudi Arabia's security and territorial integrity are inviolable, Prince Faisal declares at BRICS Summit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister stated at the BRICS Summit that the kingdom's security and territorial integrity are inviolable and will not be compromised. He emphasized that regional escalation poses increasing risks to stability in the Middle East.

stories.title: Pakistan PM calls Crown Prince to reaffirm full support and solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Pakistan PM calls Crown Prince to reaffirm full support and solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pakistan's prime minister spoke with Saudi Arabia's crown prince to discuss regional tensions and de-escalation efforts. Pakistan reaffirmed its support for Saudi Arabia and condemned attacks on the kingdom by Houthi militia.

stories.title: Pakistan PM condemns attacks on Kingdom in call with Saudi crown prince

en.title: Pakistan PM condemns attacks on Kingdom in call with Saudi crown prince
en.summary: Pakistan's prime minister held talks with Saudi Arabia's crown prince regarding regional diplomatic efforts and security developments. Both leaders condemned Houthi militia attacks and reaffirmed their strategic partnership.

en.summary: S&P Global Ratings maintained Saudi Arabia's sovereign credit ratings at A+/A-1 with a stable outlook, citing the kingdom's diversified energy infrastructure and fiscal buffers as protection against regional instability.

stories.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns attack on East-West Pipeline; affirms support for Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns attack on East-West Pipeline; affirms support for Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Arab and Islamic nations, including Pakistan, Egypt, Iraq, and others, condemned drone attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline that damaged infrastructure and injured civilians, calling such targeting of civilian and critical infrastructure a violation of international law.

stories.title: UK reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia during call between foreign ministers

en.title: UK reaffirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia during call between foreign ministers
en.summary: The UK Foreign Secretary spoke with Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister, reaffirming British solidarity with the Kingdom following Houthi militia attacks and supporting Saudi Arabia's right to defend itself under international law.

en.title: S&P Global Ratings affirms Saudi Arabia credit rating at A+ with stable outlook
en.summary: S&P Global maintained Saudi Arabia's credit rating at A+ with a stable outlook, citing the kingdom's ability to manage pressures from regional conflict through its diversified energy infrastructure and substantial reserves.
